intent: Teach each/must requirements, before-event order, all helpers subset, win-match collocation with actual victory here, not losing hope after a goal of unspecified scoring side, hoped-for beat versus achieved victory, contextual draw using explicitly new example scores and goal before unspecified whistle. Six changing models plus two order tasks; no new bitmap needed.

workshop.title: 分清人和动作，不漏否定与先后
workshop.instruction: 换角色、对搭配、看比分新例子；分清要求、希望和原句已经给出的结果。

transfer.stem: 换成访客、失误和班级，哪组三句保留全部信息？
transfer.passage:
三条新信息
每位访客都必须佩戴徽章。第一次失误之后，我们没有失去信心。我们班希望击败去年的获胜者。
词语提示：visitor访客；badge徽章；confidence信心；error失误。

options.text: Only one visitor must wear a badge. We did not lose confidence after the first error. Our class hopes to beat last year’s winners.
Each visitor must wear a badge. We lost confidence after the first error. Our class hopes to beat last year’s winners.
Each visitor must wear a badge. We did not lose confidence after the first error. Our class has already beaten last year’s winners.
Each visitor must wear a badge. We did not lose confidence after the first error. Our class hopes to beat last year’s winners.

answer.display: Each visitor must wear a badge. We did not lose confidence after the first error. Our class hopes to beat last year’s winners.

explanation.strategy: 检查each与must，再核对否定和after，最后区分希望与已经做到。

steps.text: Each visitor must wear a badge.
steps.reason: Each覆盖每位访客，must是必须，不能缩成一位。

steps.text: We did not lose confidence after the first error.
steps.reason: not不能漏，after给出第一次失误之后的时间。

steps.text: Our class hopes to beat last year’s winners.
steps.reason: hopes to表示希望，不报告已经击败。

distractors.reason: Only one把每位缩成只有一位。
lost漏掉没有，变成失去信心。
has already beaten把希望改成已经做到。

explanation.pitfall: 要求不等于已经遵守，希望不等于已经实现，否定词不能漏。

picturePurpose: Code-owned changing diagrams teach each/must scope, all helpers, win versus beat collocations, negation and time, hopes versus results and equal example scores. Two movable timelines teach warm-up and goal order. Exact labels stay in code; no bitmap is needed.
